coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of the 6 ground-truth variable items (33%): standard/unfused versus fused Adam implementations, and gradient graph complexity measured through node counts, edge counts, and visual clarity.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design varies network architecture and unrolling iterations rather than retaining them as experiment-wide constants. It does not specify Omniglot or other standard meta-learning datasets, and it uses TorchViz for both optimizer conditions rather than treating TorchViz versus TorchOpt as the visualization-tool independent variable. Additional hardware factors and human-study metrics go beyond the ground-truth design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the conclusion that fused operations reduce gradient graph complexity, yielding fewer nodes and simpler visualizations.
